correctness.rationale: The exact local Jacobian J=[[1,-5],[39/4,-40]] with D=diag(1/10,10) has modal trace -39-101ell/10 and determinant (ell-5/2)(ell-7/2). The hub-and-triples graph Laplacian decomposes into eigenvalues 0,n,1 (multiplicity k+r-1), and per triple (1,1), (1,3), (2,4), giving one unstable ell=3 iff an odd number of edges was added. Every added edge changes L by positive semidefinite rank-one matrix, so each ordered eigenvalue can enter/exit the open interval once at most. An independent matrix-eigenvalue implementation confirmed the alternating window for 45 graph snapshots k=1..3,r=0..2; finite checks do not prove n-uniform result.
